VB-CABLE by VB-Audio Software

Origin: https://www.vb-cable.com/
VB-CABLE is donationware. Donations and license purchases are welcome:
https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm
https://shop.vb-audio.com/

A2Router includes the original, unmodified base VB-CABLE package under
VB-Audio's published donationware bundling terms. VB-CABLE remains a separate
VB-Audio product, with its own copyright and end-user license (readme.txt).
It is not an A2Router-authored driver. A+B and C+D are not included.

A2Router stays portable. Driver installation occurs only after Create output in
Virtual devices. Existing healthy installations are reused. Installation requires
administrator approval. Ready endpoints can be used immediately; Windows restart
requirements or unavailable endpoints are reported. Windows may choose new default
audio devices during driver installation; review Sound settings afterward.
A2Router does not explicitly set defaults. Remove driver in Virtual devices asks
for explicit confirmation before shared-driver removal, which may need a restart.

The base package provides one shared cable, not arbitrary named instances.
Send application playback to CABLE Input and route CABLE Output to speakers
or headphones in A2Router. Driver format/latency settings belong to VB-CABLE.

For professional deployments where users cannot identify VB-CABLE or donate,
see VB-Audio's licensing terms and obtain the applicable licenses.
